mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as expanded economic activity boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day S&P 500 returns are negative while GDPC1 growth was positive in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Long-term upward trend in INDPRO (supply) index predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as sustained production growth builds market confidence.
failure_condition: 60-day S&P 500 returns are negative despite sustained upward trend in INDPRO over the period.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.0% triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to anticipated rate hikes tightening financial conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day S&P 500 returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE rising above 4.5% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate slower growth and potential recession risks.
failure_condition: 20-day S&P 500 returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 4.5% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (employment) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns via expanded economic activity and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite both GDPC1 and PAYEMS rising in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (housing demand) signals robust demand across sectors, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite simultaneous growth in GDPC1 and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion', CPIAUCSL below 2.0% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate slowing inflation and potential rate cuts.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL falling below 2.0% in the late-cycle period.
